'''Armored vests''' are a type of [[Armored Clothing|armored clothing]] that were lightweight but durable. They were similar in design to [[Flak vest/Legends|flak vests]] and [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vests]] but were significantly more robust as they could shrug off several blows from even a lightsaber yet were so light that they didn’t impede the wearer’s movement whatsoever. The vest seemed to consist of a light [[Mesh underlay|mesh]] with a layer of [[Alloy overlay|armor plates]] woven into it and an integrated [[Energy shielding|deflector shield]]<ref name="Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref><ref name="Mysteries of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>. [[Kyle Katarn]]<ref name="Dark Forces II" /> and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]<ref name="Mysteries of the Sith" /> have both worn at least one set each during their respective missions.
